create_ipc_reader: create an IpcReader instance to read Apache Arrow IPC files from a data folder
read_ipc_file: read an Apache Arrow IPC file and yield Document objects with text and id fields
iterate_ipc_batches: iterate over record batches from an Apache Arrow IPC file using pyarrow ipc reader
stream_ipc_data: stream Apache Arrow IPC data from a file as a continuous batch iterator
adapt_ipc_documents: adapt raw IPC data dicts into Document objects using a custom adapter function
